summary.text:
LG INR21700 M50, 130 km/h 90%→10%, then 0.7C charge to 80% (96s35p), ambient 35 degC
Limits: T_peak <= 45 degC, in-cell dT <= 5 degC, ready again within 180 min
39 designs, 23 feasible, 3 on the trade-off front
NOTE: bottom plates are solved in 2D (radius x height). A chiller pulling a hot-soaked pack down through its base opens large top-to-bottom gradients while it does so.
NOTE: liquid pump power covers the whole loop (7.9 mW/cell at most) and the radiator fan is charged at 3 % of the heat it rejects; chiller idle losses are not included.
Lightest       air 0.15 g/s, no filler: T_peak 39.5 degC, +1.8% mass, aux 0.29% of energy, recovery 26 min
Lowest energy  bottom 0.02 g/s, no filler: T_peak 40.4 degC, +8.2% mass, aux 0.05% of energy, recovery 36 min
Balanced       ribbon 0.02 g/s, 3.5 mm gap, no filler: T_peak 39.2 degC, +7.2% mass, aux 0.05% of energy, recovery 24 min
